title: PediBot — a paediatric answer with the source attached
description:
PediBot answers parents' questions about a sick child using only what paediatric societies, health ministries and the WHO already publish for families, and names the document every clinical sentence comes from.

Rule-based triage runs before any language model and puts the local emergency number first; a verification step rejects any draft without a valid citation or with a medicine dose that does not come from the sanctioned dosing table, so when nothing in the corpus supports an answer the system says so instead of guessing.

It ships emergency numbers for 90 countries, childhood vaccination schedules for 66, WHO growth standards, MUAC screening for acute malnutrition, and paracetamol and ibuprofen dosing from fixed tables — in eight languages, free and without an account. The source catalogue of 632 documents is released separately under CC0.

Live at pedibot.xyz. Not medical advice.
